How does the surcharge for urgent orders compare between Halcyon Engine Parts and Kestrel Marine Supply in terms of percentage for delivery to the nearest stock point within 48 hours?
key_facts: Halcyon Engine Parts: Emergency (vessel off-hire or main engine immobilised): the Supplier will dispatch from the nearest stock point within 48 hours and deliver to the vessel within 5 days worldwide, at a surcharge of 25% plus actual freight cost.

Kestrel Marine Supply: Urgent orders (vessel safety or class-critical items): dispatch within 24 hours and delivery to the vessel at any of those three hubs within 72 hours, subject to stock, at a surcharge of 20% on the item price.
cases.rationale: synthesis of Halcyon_Engine_Parts_Warranty_and_SLA.pdf p.2 and Kestrel_Marine_Supply_Warranty_and_SLA.pdf p.2

cases.question: Which spares under the warranty terms of Frame Agreement KMS-FA-2026 are covered by a warranty period of 12 months from the date of installation on board, provided that this period does not exceed the 18 months from the date of delivery or installation, whichever expires first?
key_facts: Part numbers supplied under these terms carry the prefix KMS.
Spares are warranted against defects in material and workmanship for 18 months from the date of delivery or 12 months from the date of installation on board, whichever expires first.
